about.title: Mō EncodeX
about.subtitle: He kete taputapu maha-kārienatia utu kore, puna tuwhera hoki i hangaia ki runga i te FFmpeg. Hurihia, tirohia, whakakōmitimiti, tangohia, tapahia, ā, tukatukahia ōpaki ngā ororongo, kiriata me ngā whakaahua — katoa i te wāhi kotahi.
about.description: He kete taputapu maha-kārienatia a EncodeX e kawe ana i te mana o FFmpeg ki tētahi atanga papamahi hou, māmā hoki. Hurihia ngā ororongo, kiriata me ngā whakaahua i waenga i ngā hōputu me te mana tino pai ki runga i ngā codec, reiti-bit, taumira, hōputu pika me te kounga; kapehia ngā hukihuki kāore e ngaro te kounga mō te remux hohoro; tangohia ngā ororongo i te kiriata; ā, tapahia te kiriata me tētahi pūrere tirohi-houkura tika-tonu ki te āputa. Ka tautokona te whakawaehere whakatere-pūtoro i runga i te NVIDIA NVENC, Intel QSV, AMD AMF, VAAPI, Apple VideoToolbox me Microsoft Media Foundation, me ngā whānau whakawaehere e wātea ana e kitea āunoa ana i te FFmpeg binary i tāpiritia i te wā mahi. Ka rere ngā mahi ōpaki i tētahi tūtira pūmau me te ahunga whakamua wā-tūturu, ā, ka whakaatu te aratau CLI matakore i ngā pūkenga ōrite mō te tuhituhi hōtuhi me te aunoatanga.
about.author: Kaituhi
about.feedback: Kua kitea he pōhēhē, he whakaaro anō rānei?
about.licenseSummary: Kua puta i raro i te Raihana MIT. Noa atu te whakamahi, te kape, te whakarerekē, te whakakotahi, te whakaputa, te tohatoha, te raihana-iti me te hoko — tae atu ki te tauhokohoko — engari me whakauru ngā pānui manatāpapa me ngā pānui whakaaetanga ki ngā kape katoa, ki ngā wāhanga matua rānei o te pūmanawa. Ka tukua te pūmanawa "pēnei tonu", kāore he whakapūmau o tētahi momo.
about.acknowledgements: He mea hanga ki te ❤️ mō te puna waehere tuwhera — nā te kaupapa FFmpeg me te hapori i whakahaere.
